retrieved.title: 现场光：警报红光与监视器冷光

request:
镜头 s38：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-v75）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', 'S-Cinetone']）：Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：特写，固定。黑暗里，贴着笑脸贴纸的旧铁盒放在管道边上，小灯从红色变成绿色，连闪三下。环境声：三声轻轻的提示音。
情绪：hopeful, quiet, small
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, locked-off
景深与虚实：The box and sticker sharp, the background black.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Insert in the dark: the old dented tin box with its antenna, now with the red-and-white ANET smiley sticker on its lid, sits on a pipe ledge; its small LED glows red. Blocking lock: the tin box sits at frame centre on a pipe ledge, the smiley sticker facing camera, darkness around.
Picture 2: the handmade ANET node box with the smiley sticker (prop reference; role: prop reference). Close-up product-less documentary photo of a handmade network node device on a workbench: an old dented steel ammunition tin fitted with a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny indicator LEDs (two red, one white) and a short screw-on antenna. On its lid is a slightly worn sticker that reproduces exactly the smiley speech-bubble logo from the reference image. Solder wire and a multimeter beside it.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：three soft electronic chimes, distant hum
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-insert] 机位：细节特写插入
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[rules/size/insert-shot] size
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
[ours/light-alarm-red] 现场光：警报红光与监视器冷光
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

[Shot 1] At 0.0s, close-up, locked-off camera set at the pipe ledge, start and end framing identical: a tight close-up of the tin box and its sticker, no push, no pan, no drift, the frame held perfectly still. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. At the start the tin box sits at frame centre on the pipe ledge, the smiley sticker face-on to camera; the pipe ledge runs out to frame left and frame right and disappears into black; in the foreground the near lip of the ledge is soft; the background is pure black with no detail. Start: the small indicator LED on the box burns a low steady red, its glow a tiny red bead on the sticker's gloss and on the rim of the tin, the rest of the box lit only by that bead. Middle: the red fades through a brief warm amber into green as the lamp changes state, and then the green pulses off and on three times, each dark beat a fraction longer, the green light washing across the dented lid, the antenna base and the edge of the sticker. End: the third pulse returns and holds green, the glow steady, a small green pool on the pipe ledge, the box and sticker absolutely still, the antenna casting a thin shadow. Mood: hopeful, quiet, small. Blur: the tin box, the smiley sticker and the glowing LED are sharp, the dents and the worn sticker edge crisp; the near lip of the pipe ledge and the entire background fall to black with no detail; a faint green halo blooms around the LED, and focus breathes once, almost imperceptibly, from the sticker's edge to the antenna base and back, then settles. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Three soft electronic prompt chimes, one under each blink, a low distant hum from the city beyond the pipes, a faint metallic tick as the LED changes state, the near-silent settling of the tin on the pipe ledge; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
